name: Durofy Roof Quote Calculator
author: notice01w

sections.description:
Durofy Roof Quote Calculator adds an instant estimate form to any page with the shortcode [drqc_calculator].

Visitors enter their roof size, material, pitch, stories, and whether the old roof needs tearing off. The plugin calculates a ballpark range from your own per-square-foot pricing and shows it instantly — then invites the visitor to request an exact quote. Every request is saved as a lead in your dashboard and emailed to you.

Features

  • Mobile-friendly estimate form via shortcode
  • Adjustable material rates, pitch and story multipliers, tear-off rate, and estimate range
  • Quote-request lead capture with honeypot spam protection
  • Leads dashboard with contact details and estimate summary
  • Email notification for every new quote request
  • Brand accent color to match the calculator to the site

Pro version

Need more? Durofy Roof Quote Calculator Pro adds CSV lead export, webhook / Zapier lead push, team email routing, and Twilio SMS alerts. Available from the plugin settings page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the durofy-roof-quote-calculator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Roofing Calculator → Settings to set your pricing.
  4. Add the [drqc_calculator] shortcode to any page.
sections.faq:
Where do quote requests go?

They appear under Roofing Calculator → Quote Requests in your dashboard, and a notification email is sent to the address in Settings.

Can I change the pricing?

Yes. Every rate and multiplier is adjustable under Roofing Calculator → Settings.
sections.changelog:
0.5.2

  • Get Pro button in Settings now points to the Pro sales page (roof.durofy.com).

0.5.1

  • Renamed to Durofy Roof Quote Calculator (distinctive name requested by the review team). New slug: durofy-roof-quote-calculator; prefixes and shortcode renamed to match.

0.5.0

  • WordPress.org compliance release: removed locked Pro features from the directory version (CSV export, webhook/CRM push, team email routing, SMS alerts now live in the Pro version, sold separately).
  • Removed Freemius SDK from the directory version.
  • Renamed internal prefixes and shortcode ([drqc_calculator]) to meet directory guidelines.
  • Brand accent color is now free for all users.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

0.4.0

  • Freemius SDK bundled: Pro licenses, checkout, renewals, and trials now live.

0.3.0

  • New Pro features: webhook/Zapier lead push, team email routing, brand accent color, Twilio SMS alerts.
  • Fixed: admin capability now filterable in the clean build (was testbed-only).

0.2.0

  • Renamed to Roof Quote Calculator (new WordPress.org slug: roof-quote-calculator).
  • Pro groundwork: CSV lead export and white-label, gated for the upcoming Pro version.
  • New shortcode alias: [roof_quote_calculator] ([roofing_calculator] still works).

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
